chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al-Harith ibn Al-Ahowl, from Bureyd, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), regarding the slave woman who commits adultery,
He (peace be upon him) said: 'She is whipped half the penalty (Hadd) of the free person, whether she had a husband or not.'
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a slave woman who commits adultery according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of proportional punishment in Shia jurisprudence, where a slave woman’s hadd for adultery is reduced to half that of a free person, irrespective of her marital status. It reflects the classical legal distinction between 'abd' (slave) and 'hurra' (free woman), emphasizing that the marital bond does not alter the base penalty for the slave class in this specific context.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Haris Bin Al Ahowl, from Bureyd, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> regarding the slave woman who committed adultery.
Heasws said: ‘She would be whipped half the Penalty (Hadd) of the free, whether she had a husband for her, or there did not happen to be one’.
